subject: Updated commit / best-case definitions — pilot rollout & ambassador nominations
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Updated commit / best-case definitions — pilot rollout & ambassador nominations

Hi team,

Quick note to kick off the pilot for the revised forecast categories. The Research + Finance folks finalized the definitions for Commit / Best Case / Pipeline last week (attached: forecast_commit_bestcase_definitions_v2.pdf). Key changes in plain language:
- Commit now requires signed PO, legal review complete, or an unambiguous purchase order with an approved billing date.
- Best Case is for opportunities with clear technical/PO signals (e.g., final pricing agreed, exec alignment) but missing one required procurement artifact.
- Pipeline remains earlier-stage pipeline (active outreach, unclear timing).

Why this matters: we need a clean signal for monthly rollups and to reduce forecast noise. The pilot goal is to validate the definitions against real deals, surface ambiguous cases, and iterate on HubSpot stage mappings.

What I need from you by EOD Friday (2026-12-04):
- Nominate a pair of forecast ambassadors from your pod who can attend a 1-hour model calibration on 12/08 and then run two 30-minute huddles with sellers the week of 12/13.
- Confirm whether any live deals you own would land in the "clarify" queue under the new definitions (one-line examples are fine).

I'm attaching the definitions doc and a draft HubSpot mapping (hubspot_stage_mapping_v1.csv) — please take a quick look. We'll run a 60-minute readout on 12/22 to lock adoption cadence and any automation we need.

Thanks — this is intentionally time-boxed to avoid long debates. We can refine after the pilot based on actual edge cases.

Best,
Hannah

Hannah Schmitt
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: forecast_commit_bestcase_definitions_v2.pdf (application/pdf)

Hannah / team — appreciate the clear ask. Two operational notes from Sales Ops: 
1) We should codify the new definitions into HubSpot automation flags (boolean fields) so Managers can filter by "meets_commit_criteria". I've attached a draft CSV of proposed stage mappings (hubspot_stage_mapping_v1.csv).
2) For enforcement, suggest a weekly "clarify" queue review in the manager cadence where ambiguous deals are routed to ambassadors for a determination before the commit freeze (two business days before close-of-month).

I'll sync with Ops next week to scope what automation is required. If anyone has objections to the weekly review cadence, call it out now.

Vivek

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Updated commit / best-case definitions — pilot rollout & ambassador nominations — Readout and next steps

Folks — thanks for the work on the pilot. Summary from today's readout and decisions: 

What we validated:
- Commit definition (signed PO / completed legal) gives a stable, low-noise signal — ~78% accuracy in our sample of 52 closed/won deals.
- Best Case captured deals where exec alignment + pricing existed but procurement artifacts lagged (23% of ambiguous cases).
- HubSpot mappings need a small tweak for renewal-managed contracts (mapped out in the attached CSV).

Decisions & next steps:
1) Go-live date for org-wide enforcement: 2027-01-10. From that date managers will only include "Commit" in forecast if the commit boolean is set.
2) Ambassador program: Marissa's nominees (Priya, Logan) + nominations from Karthik's team (Karthik to confirm) will run the weekly clarify reviews starting week of 2027-01-11.
3) Automation: Ops to implement a "meets_commit_criteria" boolean in HubSpot and a manager queue for ambiguous deals. Ops to estimate by 2027-01-04.
4) Training: two recorded sessions + three live drop-in hours. Slides are attached (ambassador_training_slides.pptx) and recordings will be uploaded to the Drive link.

Open items (owners):
- Karthik: confirm ambassador list by 2026-12-29.
- Ops (Vivek): scope automation & ETA by 2027-01-04.
- Marissa: upload 10-deal sample to Drive for the training.

If no objections, I'll publish the go-live note to the wider sales mailing list tomorrow and create the calendar events for the training.

Thanks again — this is the kind of focused, time-boxed run that will help clean the numbers quickly.

Best,
Hannah
